title: Keep the slice path out of next --show text
lead: Plain next no longer prints the slice path. `next --show` still appends the rendered slice, and that banner names the source file.
findings_note: next --show still printed .slicer/slices/S01.json in the generated banner while checking s166
boundary: **Not in this slice:** changing the text of `slicer show`; changing the banner stored in `.slicer/render/`; removing `path` from JSON.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `next --show` prints the show hint, then `render_slice`. The banner begins `Source: .slicer/slices/ID.json`. That line is the same invitation to open the tracking file that the old path line was. The on-disk render and `slicer show` keep the banner, because it is how a generated file names its source.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/cli.py` (the text `next --show` prints)
- `tests/test_next.py`
- `docs/commands.md` and `docs/agents.md` if they still say `next --show` text includes the source path
- `CHANGELOG.md`

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. Text for `next --show`, when the item has a slice, contains the show hint and the slice body, and does not contain the slice JSON path.
2. `slicer show` text is unchanged and still includes the generated banner with the source path.
3. The file under `.slicer/render/slices/` still starts with that banner.
4. JSON from `next` and `next --show` still includes `path`. `--json --lean` still drops it on an item.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: When `next --show` prints the slice, omit the source path from that stdout. Leave `render_slice` bytes for files on disk unchanged, and leave `slicer show` unchanged.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: The failing tests pass, then `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests`, `slicer check`, and `git diff --check`.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch, including the re-rendered roadmap and a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased.
